title: 드론작전사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Emergency Measures during Drone Operations, etc.)
(1) Where emergency measures are necessary during drone operations or in response to a disaster, the Commander may temporarily direct and supervise units located within the Command's jurisdiction that are neither assigned nor attached to the Command.
(2) Where the Commander has directed and supervised other units that are neither assigned nor attached to the Command under paragraph (1), the Commander shall, without delay, report the circumstances to the Minister of National Defense and the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and notify the commander of the higher unit to which each such unit belongs.
